items.title: Absolute profinite rigidity of all torsion-free lamplighter groups Z^n wreath Z
items.author: Nikolay Nikolov; Julian Wykowski
items.difficulty_reason: The absolute rigidity theorem reconstructs the larger abelian base module from only profinite data, using an infinite system of maximal nilpotent quotients, verbal subgroup closure/central-series invariance, lifting centralizers and identifying a twisted completed module, then invoking Noetherian-domain module rigidity and Quillen-Suslin. Original finite-generation, residual-finiteness and positive-rank conventions retained. This is a complete global group rigidity result beyond the old N-abelian support lemma.

primary.label: complete original main theorem in its native restatable environment

proof_spans.label: complete author proof roadmap, profinite central-series preliminaries, nilpotent quotients, centralizer lifting, identification of the abelian module and module-rigidity/Quillen-Suslin conclusion

contexts.label: original absolute profinite-rigidity and torsion-free lamplighter/module definitions
